propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity alerts for incomplete-url-substring-sanitization at lines 249 and 250 where assertions use startswith on base_url strings
The startswith prefix check on URLs is insufficient because a different host sharing the prefix (e.g., https://fallback.test.evil.example) would incorrectly satisfy the assertion
The test intends to verify that a model was built against a configured fallback endpoint, but the weak substring check does not enforce that verification
URL origin comparison using parsed (scheme, netloc) tuples via urllib.parse.urlsplit eliminates substring ambiguity and resolves the CodeQL alerts
After the fix, CodeQL re-scanning confirms zero open py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts and the test still catches regressions when the endpoint is not properly threaded
